texts.preamble: Shiras S vs State Of Kerala on 11 August, 2022 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr.Justice Ziyad Rahman A.A. Thursday, The 11Th Day Of August 2022 / 20Th Sravana, 1944 Crl.Mc No. 5410 Of 2022 Cc 1203/2015 Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -Ii,Nedumangad Petitioner/Accused No.1 To 3: 1 Shiras S. S/O Shukkoor, Val;Avilputhenveedu Nedumangad, , Pin - 695541 2 K.A Johny S/O Antony ,Licensee Trichur Tea Agencies, Bazar Road, Mattacherry, Kochi-682006, Ernakulam Residing At 6-15, Kochi Corporation 3 M/S. Tata Coffee Ltd Pollibetta, South Kodagu, Kodagu, Karanataka - 570215 Person In Charge, Head Office Tata Coffee Ltd, Pollibetta, Kodagu, Karnataka Nominee Under Fss Act By Advs. Adv Sharan Shahier Adv P.Benny Thomas Adv Abel Tom Benny Respondents/State & Defacto Complainant: 1 State Of Kerala Represented Public Prosecutor, High Court Of Kerala, Kochin, Pin - 682031 2 The Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India Science And Standards (S&S) Division, Fba Bhavan, Kotla Road, New Delhi - 110002 Represented By Its Joint Director Crl.Mc No. 5410 Of 2022 2 Shiras S vs State Of Kerala on 11 August, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13154819/ 1 3 The Food Safety Officer, Nedumangad Circle Trivandrum - 695541 By Advs. Adv Sreej V. -Public Prosecutor Adv Santhan V.Nair Adv Chithra P.George This Criminal Misc. Case Having Come Up For Admission On 11.08.2022, The Court On The Same Day Passed The Following: Crl.Mc No. 5410 Of 2022 3 Order The petitioners are the accused Nos.1 to 3 in C.C. No.1203/2015 pending before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court Ii, Nedumangad. The prosecution was launched on the basis Annexure A complaint
texts.facts: submitted by the 3 rd respondent alleging violation of Section 3(1)(zz)(xii), Section 26(1) & (2) (i), and Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act read with Regulation 2.10.1(1) of the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 and any other relevant Sections/Rules/Regulations thereunder. 2. The main allegation against the petitioner is that, the tea sold by the petitioner was found to be adulterated as it contained iron fillings beyond the permissible limits. This Crl.M.C. is filed for quashing all further proceedings pursuant to Annexure A complaint.
texts.arguments: The specific contention put forward by the learned counsel for the petitioner is that, as per Annexure B Circular issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, the prosecution in all cases with the aforesaid allegations, cause of action of which arose prior to 19.05.2016, were directed to be withdrawn. The reason for the same is that, even though the permissible limit of iron filling in the tea was fixed at the relevant time, there was no recognized mechanism for assessing the quantity of the same.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The specific contention put forward by the learned counsel for the petitioner is that, as per Annexure B Circular issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, the prosecution in all cases with the aforesaid allegations, cause of action of which arose prior to 19.05.2016, were directed to be withdrawn. The reason for the same is that, even though the permissible limit of iron filling in the tea was fixed at the relevant time, there was no recognized mechanism for assessing the quantity of the same.
